#  12896 - Computational Engineering Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **12896 - module is no longer offered from SS 2022**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Computational Engineering**  |  
|  Computational Engineering   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 1 - Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Dr.-Ing. Trieschmann, Jan 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every summer semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | The students are familiar with the basic numerical methods and are able to assign them according to the specified engineering questions. Furthermore, they are able to formulate and implement appropriate algorithms.   |  
| Contents:  | 
  * Fundamentals of numerical implementations
  * Numerical solution of systems of linear equations
  * Numerical differentiation and integration
  * Ordinary differential equations and initial value problems
  * Boundary value problems an partial differential equations
  * Monte Carlo methods

 |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Knowledge of the topics of modules:
  * Modul 11107 Mathematics - T1
  * Modul 11108 Mathematics - T2
  * Modul 11206 Mathematics - T3
  * Modul 12105 Introduction to Programming

 |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 1 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 135 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | 
  * A.L. Garcia, Numerical Methods for Physics
  * I.H. Hutchinson, A Student's Guide to Numerical Methods
  * W.H. Press et al., Numerical Recipes

 |  
| Module Examination:  | Prerequisite + Final Module Examination (MAP)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  |  **Prerequisite:**
  * Successful participation in project tasks during the semester, to be delivered until end of lecture period

**Final Module Examination:**
  * Oral examination, 45 min

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | None  |  
| Module Components:  | 
  * Lecture Computational Engineering - 2 Hours per Week per Semester
  * Exercise Computational Engineering - 1 Hours per Week per Semester
  * Examination Computational Engineering

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Follow-up Module/s:  |  Phase-out module since: 11.02.2022 
  * without Follow-up Module/s

 |
